stages.name: clarification
stages.description: Optional pre-planning clarification of ambiguous requirements before strategic review.

sprint_stages.name: scrum_master
sprint_stages.description: Breaks the sprint goal into concrete task cards with estimates. Non-blocking — sprint continues on failure.

sprint_stages.name: sprint_delta
sprint_stages.description: Sprint 2+: classifies each file as create/update/patch so FileStructurePlanner sets operations reliably. No-op on Sprint 1.

sprint_stages.name: file_planner
sprint_stages.description: Plans the full file tree for this sprint: paths, purposes, responsible_stage (backend/frontend), and tech stack.

sprint_stages.name: backend
sprint_stages.description: Generates backend source files. One LLM call per file; syntax-validated before write.

sprint_stages.name: frontend
sprint_stages.description: Generates frontend source files. One LLM call per file; syntax-validated before write.

sprint_stages.name: sprint_deploy
sprint_stages.description: Validates the sprint build: Dockerfile check, import resolution, basic smoke test.

sprint_stages.name: sprint_review
sprint_stages.description: Summarises sprint output quality and flags issues for the next sprint's context.
